ننثال (form VII)
# نَنْثَالُ (nanṯālu) /nan.θaː.lu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْثَالَ (inṯāla)
# نَنْثَالَ (nanṯāla) /nan.θaː.la/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْثَالَ (inṯāla)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
